subject: general
question: ___________ becomes second Indian state to achieve 100% literacy.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Goa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Goa becomes second Indian state to achieve 100% literacy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Goa has achieved 100% literacy** under the **ULLAS Nav Bharat Literacy Programme**.

 
 
• 
 
**ULLAS** stands for **Understanding for Lifelong Learning for All in Society**.

 
 
• 
 
Also known as **New India Literacy Programme (NILP)**.

 
 
• 
 
It is a **centrally sponsored scheme**, aligned with the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**.

 
 
• 
 
Targets individuals **aged 15 and above** who missed formal schooling.

 
 
• 
 
Focuses on **functional literacy** – reading, writing, and numeracy.

 
 
• 
 
Aims to achieve **100% national literacy by 2030**.

 
 
• 
 
The milestone was announced during **Goa’s 39th Statehood Day**.
